title: A City Intertwined
description: The Bayshore Freeway was completed in 1937 and is part of U.S. Route 101, connecting San Jose with San Francisco. "The slick concrete highway was constructed to ferry affluent suburban residents to office towers downtown," writes Gregory Harris, curator of photography at the HighMuseum of Art, in photographer Mimi Plumb's new book, Blazing Light. "What initially drew Plumb to the scene was the striking light, but upon further consideration, the image seemed to ask, 'Is this progress, and who benefits?'”
translated_description: 贝肖尔高速公路于1937年竣工，是美国101号公路的一部分，连接圣何塞与旧金山。高等艺术博物馆摄影策展人格雷戈里·哈里斯在摄影师米米·普拉姆的新书《炽烈之光》中写道："这条光滑的混凝土高速公路是为运送富裕的郊区居民前往市中心的办公大楼而修建的。最初吸引普拉姆的是那引人注目的光线，但进一步思考后，这幅影像似乎在发问：'这是进步吗？谁又从中受益？'"
